subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB565 (2026-09-13). 'A report group description entry that contains an OCCURS clause with a DEPENDING phrase may be followed within that report group only by report group description entries that are subordinate to it.' ReportOccursOf computes the entry's subtree end (the level-number hierarchy of 13.15) and, when the DEPENDING phrase is present, rejects with COBOL2021 if the next entry inside the group is not subordinate. MEASURED: the rule fired on the first draft of the positive golden, whose DEPENDING entry stood third of five - the golden now writes it LAST, which is the rule's own consequence and is why the leg is a real observation rather than a claim.
